title: Assumptions & Constraints Manifest (ACM) Metadata Schema
description: Specification schema for the YAML frontmatter of an Assumptions & Constraints Manifest (v1.1).

acm_version.description: Specification version of the ACM document.

risk_level.description: Operational risk assessment based on boundary stability.

contracts.description: Core operational and architectural runtime contract declarations.

idempotency.description: Execution repeatability guarantees without duplicate side-effects.

concurrency_safety.description: Protection against race conditions and interleaving under concurrent execution.

horizontal_scalability.description: Safety across multi-replica, stateless node clusters without local memory reliance.

strict_ordering.description: Dependency on sequential FIFO message/event arrival.

data_loss_safety.description: Protection against silent message dropping or uncommitted writes during failure.

distributed_primitives.description: Distributed systems execution and degradation semantics.

degradation_mode.description: System posture during downstream dependency outages.

tags.description: Optional architectural, subsystem, or infrastructure tags.

evidence.description: Concrete reference to code line, lock mechanism, or test proving the contract (required if guaranteed).

conditions.description: Prerequisites under which this contract holds (required if conditional).

failure_mode.description: Specific failure or corruption mode when execution violates this invariant (required if unsupported).

scope.description: Specific submodules, endpoints, or file paths where this contract applies.
